item.title: Filmmaking Camps 2026 Premiere
item.description:
Saturday, August 15, 2026 at 12 PM

Location: 5601A Navigation Blvd, Houston, TX 77011

Aurora Picture Show and the Museum of Fine Arts, Houston present the free premiere screening of short films made collaboratively by artists ages 7-15 in Aurora’s 2026 Summer Youth Filmmaking Camps at the museum’s Brown Auditorium.
